title: ModelRouterRecommendation
description: Output of the model-router skill: a single, deterministic model recommendation for a Claude Code task. Returned as a structured JSON object with no surrounding prose.

model.description: Recommended Claude model ID. Must be one of the four approved IDs unless overridden by CLAUDE_PIN_MODEL.

class.description: Task classification produced by task-class-routing. 'unknown' is allowed only when a hard fence short-circuits before classification runs.

confidence.description: Confidence in the recommendation. Floor of 0.9 for any fence/role/destructive lock. Below 0.55 means the caller should ask the user before downshifting.

reason.description: Primary reason code. The highest-priority signal that determined the recommendation.

escalation_triggers_seen.description: Ordered list of every escalation trigger or pin that fired during routing. Empty array means the class-map output was used unchanged.

fence_hit.description: The matched keyword, path glob, or role label that triggered a fence. Empty string when no fence fired.

notes.description: Optional clarifying note (≤140 chars). Only set when the recommendation needs clarification beyond the reason code.
